about_the_game:
Based on the book Story for Karol from Friedrich Alfredo Stevenson

Karol World Breaker brings classic brick-breaking gameplay together with Survivors-like mechanics in a single game. Destroy enemies with your balls and power-ups. Collect coins that you can use to buy power-up items in the Store to help you in holding out against waves of falling enemies. These wise Enemies are capable of spawning debuffs that will make your adventure more difficult.

In Karol World Breaker ancient wisdom meets modern Roguelike gaming in a touching tale that will captivate you.

Follow Karol as she unexpectedly finds herself transported into a mysterious video game world unlike any she's played before. She encounters digital manifestations of great thinkers who become her guides through levels filled with powerful life lessons. When loneliness threatens to overwhelm her, Karol must learn that true companionship begins with understanding herself.

Karol unlocks timeless wisdom that helps her see her real-world challenges in a new light. As she progresses through this unusual adventure, she discovers that the most important power-ups aren't the ones that make you stronger or faster, but those that make you wiser.
Immerse yourself in a thoughtfully crafted world where:

Video game excitement meets philosophical discovery
Beautiful illustrations bring both digital and spiritual worlds to life
Complex ideas become accessible through playful storytelling
